045. The same broken edit corrupted the Apache configuration twice
Batch: 5469 | Execution: 2026-09-03__11-57-11 | Severity: Medium
Task: internal-ca-tls-bash-rhel9-5469
Problem: Two sed commands prepended certificate-chain text to every line of ssl.conf. The executor repeated the corrupt/edit/reinstall cycle before correcting the pattern. The configuration was eventually repaired; the repeated unchecked transformation is the failure.
Why a production administrator should care: An unchecked edit to account or service configuration can break access or running services. Stage and validate edits before applying them, and stop repeating a transformation after it has already corrupted the target.
